note: Reviewed CDB90 match 16, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Jankov municipality identifies the whole 6 March 1645 battle and Torstensson against Hatzfeld. Hatzfeld's army includes Bavarian supporting troops; both full source forces remain local. CDB attacker/defender designations are preserved as source side keys, not rewritten from modern descriptions of the tactical initiative. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name IMP ARMY): CDB IMP ARMY includes supporting Bavarian units described in the municipal campaign history. Retain a single local army and the original total rather than assigning it solely to a catalogue polity. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name SW ARMY): CDB SW ARMY / TORSTENSSON is the Swedish field army identified by Jankov's battle history. The source defender key and total are retained.
